```python
qos.py fprisc --pin record
```

Binary.u16le combines two bytes at an offset by first extracting the first byte using `u16be` and then extracting the second byte using `u16be` on the result of the first operation. The `u16be` function converts a 16-bit value to big-endian format by masking the lower 16 bits and shifting them left by 16 positions.

```sol
u16le a b = u16be (u16be a b).
```
